visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. First screen is Split + plat inventory face, not a Stage or Field cage.
competitiveTarget: Beat the Zillow and Redfin subdivision pages. First screen is H1 '{Name} homes for sale', a plat-inventory face (count + median list from getPlatPublicInventory via publishPlatFigures), and flagship PlaceSplitView of that counted set. Ridge is a /subdivisions URL, not /communities/ridge. Seed a map ring only when GIS stored a real polygon — Ridge historically has none, so the camera is pin bounds, never an invented hull. Never say plat on the public page. Giant 0 is forbidden on a timed-out read. Schools only if the MLS modal publishes. Yearly sold 2021–2025 counts sit below the fold.
note: Place-page class opener, amended 2026-09-03. Order is V3Breadcrumb, place-opening (V3Heading `{Name} homes for sale` + PlaceFaceStrip plat-inventory face + V3SourceLine + full-bleed PlaceAreaHero photo), V3Atlas (self ring), PlaceTypeSlider (getPublicPlaceSegments, same leftover extra-type feed as the other grains), PlaceSplitView of the counted set (overlayBoundaries from atlas children, empty here because this grain is self), SubdivisionSchools, Instrument (plat market below the fold), SubdivisionSalesHistory + SubdivisionMarketCharts, V3PlaceCharacter, SubdivisionDocuments, Footer. Face SoR is getPlatPublicInventory + publishPlatFigures; publishPlaceFace({ grain: 'subdivision', hud: null, active, medianList }) — no MOS, DTP, 30-day sold, parent leftover, or closed-12mo on the live face. THE PARENT PULSE IS GONE AND MUST NOT COME BACK. Seed a map ring only when GIS stored a real polygon. Yearly closed counts stay in SubdivisionSalesHistory below the fold. Schools stay in SubdivisionSchools; omit a level the modal does not publish. Parks/trails stay Quiet edges, not an invented rail.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: BreadcrumbList + Place JSON-LD, the same two payloads and the same hasMap condition the KB page emitted. ci:ai-structured-data pins this route to MetadataBlock by name.

requiredComponents.name: V3Chrome
requiredComponents.section: The public header, mounted by app/layout.tsx. Not a page-level import; ci:mockup-parity auto-satisfies this entry while the layout owns the header.

requiredComponents.name: V3SectionTracker
requiredComponents.section: Page-level analytics. It derives pageType from the path and lib/analytics/page-type.ts maps /subdivisions/ to 'subdivision'.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Home > Communities > the parent resort or city > this place.

requiredComponents.name: V3Heading
requiredComponents.section: H1 is the plat name. Never 'plat'. Never Homes for sale in {Name}.

requiredComponents.name: V3Button
requiredComponents.section: SITE-47: the opening's door row (.plat-opening__doors) — one primary door to the browse path ("See every home for sale") and one ghost to a broker, in the fold beneath the caption. Neither captured viewport of this class held a next action before this pass.

requiredComponents.name: PlaceSplitView
requiredComponents.section: Flagship Split of the counted plat inventory. Seed ring only from a real GIS polygon. Pin bounds when there is no ring.

requiredComponents.name: SubdivisionSchools
requiredComponents.section: Quiet, route-local. Assigned schools only when getSubdivisionSchools publishes a modal that clears the DAL threshold. Do not invent an elementary. Then every outbound edge (parks, trails, parent places, browse path). ci:subdivision-stats-integrity requires this component by name.

requiredComponents.name: V3Instrument
requiredComponents.section: The place's own market below the fold: publishPlatFigures median (DTP and 30-day sold WITHHOLD), Market Truth recorded counts, the market_stats_cache ytd row, and (SITE-24) the plat's LIFETIME closed count attributed by point-in-polygon out of subdivision_plat_closed_mv. Its chart is the MLS-name yearly series when that join produced one, and otherwise the SAME boundary union grouped by year — never both, because the yearly Ledger below prints the name-joined counts and two populations may not sit under one heading. Not the live face.

requiredComponents.name: SubdivisionSalesHistory
requiredComponents.section: Ledger, route-local. Yearly closed single-family counts from getSubdivisionSalesHistory. Counts only. Below the fold.

requiredComponents.name: SubdivisionMarketCharts
requiredComponents.section: Chart-room cards inside the sales-history section. Every floor and withheld year is named in each card's Source trace.

requiredComponents.name: V3PlaceCharacter
requiredComponents.section: Build years and HOA stated as sentences, because PLACE_CONTENT_RULES R1-R3 forbid publishing them as bare figures.

requiredComponents.name: SubdivisionDocuments
requiredComponents.section: Recorded instruments held for this place, every row a door.

requiredComponents.name: V3Atlas
requiredComponents.section: #atlas -- the living map scoped to the subdivision: every active, pending, and 30-day-closed listing inside the recorded boundary as points over a heat field, its places as touchable silhouettes, type toggles, a price scrubber. Same builder as the homepage (one source). Matt 2026-09-01: heat maps on every page.

requiredComponents.name: PlaceTypeSlider
requiredComponents.section: Horizontal type cards from getPublicPlaceSegments, the same leftover extra-type feed city / neighborhood / community use. Replaces stacked V3PlacePropertyTypes Instruments. Miss omits (slider hides when fewer than two cards).

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: Footer, rendered outside <main> so the page ships a contentinfo landmark.

requiredComponents.name: V3Answers
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 8, #faq, and this route's FIRST question set (site queue SITE-08). Verified questions from buildPlaceAnswers, each row carrying the ONE figure it is about — the figure on the closed row, the drawing and the §0 trace inside it — and the SAME array feeds the FAQPage JSON-LD through answersFaqItems, so the markup cannot describe a sentence the page does not print. WHAT THE PLAT GRAIN MAY ANSWER, and the short set is the point: REGISTRY §4 withholds every closed-price statistic at this grain (a closed median, a YoY of it, and a sale-to-list ratio, all off an MLS SubdivisionName join where most plats never reach ten detached sales in 36 months), and lib/market/geo-grain-trust.ts refuses this grain's closed attribution, so months of supply is withheld too. The verdict question is still ASKED and answered with the refusal plus the closed count behind it (the SITE-01 sentence pattern), never dropped. What publishes: the live list median of the plat's own actives (publishPlatFigures), median days on market from the plat's own market_stats_cache ytd row, the counted active set, the latest COMPLETE calendar year's closed count — never the running partial year — from getSubdivisionSalesHistory, or, when that name join is empty (every sub-plat of a resort: its homes are filed under the resort's MLS name), the same year off the boundary union, carrying its own trace and its own population noun because the boundary count is every property type; and the plat's lifetime closed count inside its recorded boundary, drawn as a tally (SITE-24). Doors are the browse path, the parent resort or city, and /how-we-get-our-numbers. Closes the page after SubdivisionDocuments, so no two adjacent sections share a pattern.

layoutComponents.name: PublicNav
layoutComponents.note: Resolves to V3Chrome. Not in requiredComponents as itself because the gate checks the route file; the V3Chrome entry above is the one the gate auto-satisfies.

jsonLd: BreadcrumbList, from the same trail array V3Breadcrumb renders.
Place, with address and containedInPlace only when the page resolved a city, and hasMap only when a polygon or at least one plotted listing exists.
FAQPage, built by answersFaqItems FROM the V3Answers rows this page renders and from nothing else (SITE-08). This route emitted no FAQPage at all before 2026-09-08.
dataLayer: getGeoBoundaryMapData({ geoType: 'subdivision', geoSlug: slug }) — the stored polygon, if any. Seed Split ring only when it is a real polygon. Ridge historically has none; do not invent a hull.

getPlatPublicInventory(slug) — THE COUNTED SET: recorded SFR + PUBLIC_ACTIVE. Face count and median and Split listings come from this set. Do not fall back to a capped featured fetch or an unfiltered pin count; those were the 12 / 14 / 26 split on Ridge At Eagle Crest (2026-08-16).
getListingTiles({ listingKeys, status: 'active', propertyType: 'A', limit: 250 }) — hydrates the counted keys for PlaceSplitView. Filtered back to the counted set.
publishPlaceFace({ grain: 'subdivision', hud: null, active, medianList }) — live face. MOS / DTP / 30d sold / leftover parent / closed-12mo stay off the face.
publishPlatFigures — plat median may publish; days-to-pending and 30-day sold withhold. ci:publish-plat-figures.
getSubdivisionCounts(slug) — Market Truth recorded detached counts and extras, below the fold.
getSubdivisionSalesHistory(slug) — yearly Ledger below the fold, counts only.
getMarketStats({ geoType: 'subdivision', geoSlug: slug, periodType: 'ytd' }) — this place's own cache row. ci:subdivision-stats-integrity pins the period.
getSubdivisionSchools(city, alias) — only when a registry match exists; omit a level the modal does not publish. ci:subdivision-stats-integrity pins the call.
getPlaceDocuments('subdivision', slug) and getPlaceCharacter('subdivision', slug) — documents and character.
getIndexableSubdivisions() — robots policy in generateMetadata AND the place's city.

getPlatClosedCount(slug) — public.subdivision_plat_closed_mv: the plat's lifetime closed sales attributed by ST_Contains against its recorded polygon, unioned over distinct listing_key with the MLS-name match, plus closedByYear. Feeds the indexability gate, the market band's figure and series, and two FAQ rows (SITE-24).
sectionOrder: V3Heading #overview (photograph owns the fold: breadcrumb, H1, leftover face on the still)
V3Atlas #atlas -- the living map scoped to the subdivision (renders only with a recorded boundary and at least one listing inside it)
SubdivisionSchools (Quiet: assigned schools when published, then every outbound edge)
SubdivisionSalesHistory (yearly counts) with SubdivisionMarketCharts inside it
V3Answers #faq (the cited question set, and the source of the FAQPage payload)
removedComponents: V3Stage and V3Field as the first-screen cage (Split + inventory face open the page)
V3Ledger as the homes body (sales history and documents still use Ledger in their own files)
KbHero (count and median are the PlaceFaceStrip)
KbListingMap and PlaceMapListSplit (PlaceSplitView is the map+list)
SubdivisionExploreTail, and with it KbExploreTowns and KbSell
The parent-market band and fetchSubdivMarketExtras (another geography under this heading — 3f34bf65, 2026-08-16)

tasteReview.evaluator: grok-4.6 via npx tsx scripts/taste-evaluate.ts subdivision --shots desktop.png,mobile375.png --url http://127.0.0.1:3211/subdivisions/ridge-at-eagle-crest --beat 59 (SITE-86). Three scorings median 63 on first-viewport Ridge shots.
tasteReview.beats: Zillow subdivision/neighborhood pages — this fold wins on months-of-supply as two named bars (14 homes vs 2.2 sales, about 6.5 months) and a plat Atlas with a price scrubber in the first viewport; it still loses eagle-crest.com on setting photography and story.

defects.section: mobile atlas (RIDGE AT EAGLE CREST RIGHT NOW)
defects.finding: At 375 the plat is a mute illustration: no price scrubber, no House filter, no zoom, and no 14-homes claim, so the map does not do the job the desktop Atlas does.
The listing-alert ask (email field and Email me each one) sits in the desktop first viewport and is absent from the 375 first viewport, so the place-page job is not one path on the phone.

defects.section: new listings numeral and MOS counts
defects.finding: The 4 in the new-listings sentence and the 14 / 2.2 bar labels are static type, not beui Number digit-swap slots; a visitor cannot recognize the catalog motion object at beui.dev/components/motion/number.

defects.section: SEO doors (homes for sale / Redmond / Map / Eagle Crest overview)
defects.finding: The four crawlable doors render as a wrapped underlined list that occupies the 375 fold between Atlas and MOS; they help SEO but they are a crawl dump in the composition.

defects.section: MOS (HOMES FOR SALE VS A MONTH OF SALES)
defects.finding: The two named bars state the 6.5-month claim but reward no hover or tap with the underlying closes, so the only interactive data object in the fold is the desktop Atlas scrubber.
